subject: Weekend plans and a printer hiccup
text:
Hi there,

I have a quiet weekend. I plan to water plants. I also want to sort books. My printer stopped working again. It makes a small clicking sound. I checked the paper tray. It looked fine. I restarted the device. Nothing changed. I think the roller is worn. I can call support later. That may help. I will borrow a machine soon. Maybe I can visit your place. We can test my old laptop. Bring a USB cable. That would help. We can make coffee. Talk about simple things. The weather looks mild. I like staying home most of the day. Maybe we can meet Saturday. Let me know if you are around.
